name: Can Tho Heritage Marathon 2026
short_description: Can Tho Heritage Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 20 December 2026 in Can Tho, over 5 km, 10 km and 21 km.
ai_summary: Can Tho Heritage Marathon 2026 (Giai Marathon Quoc te Di san Can Tho) is on Sunday 20 December 2026, organised by DHA Vietnam with the Can Tho Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism and the Vietnam Athletics Federation. The 2026 edition offers three distances, 5 km, 10 km and 21 km, with no full marathon. The organisers state the course is AIMS-standardised and that results can be used to register for the Abbott World Marathon Majors age-group world championships.

core_facts.organizer: DHA Vietnam (Duc Huong Anh Co., Ltd) with the Can Tho Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism
core_facts.venue: Song Hau Park (Cong vien Song Hau), Cai Khe ward, Can Tho

faqs.question: Is there a full marathon at Can Tho Heritage Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: No. The organiser's event page lists three distances for 2026: 5 km, 10 km and 21 km. The 2024 edition included a 42.195 km full marathon, and some calendars still show one, but the organiser describes the 2026 race as a 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon event.

faqs.question: How much does Can Tho Heritage Marathon 2026 cost?
faqs.answer: Fees rise through five tiers from August to 15 November. The 21 km costs 495,000 VND in the flash sale, 650,000 VND at early bird (7 September to 15 October) and 2,000,000 VND in the late tier. Transfers cost 300,000 VND, and entry fees are not refunded.
